finding: 72-page controlled process manual (owner: Commissioner Customs) giving numbered stepwise instructions per sub-process: shipping line submits amendment request, first-point-of-entry Revenue Authority forwards system notification, destination Partner State Customs approves/rejects, payment notification issued, amended manifest transmitted; includes flow charts and a RACI matrix.
limitations: 2019 edition; document says it is an intranet compendium item, so currency on the public site is not guaranteed; URA-specific adaptation of an EAC regional procedure.
